channel.title: Architectural Digest India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Architectural Digest India (architecturaldigest.in)

item.title: 4 minimalist office spaces that cut the clutter
item.description: Across studios and corporate offices in India, these minimalist office spaces respond to fast-paced workdays with designs shaped for calm, focus and ease.

item.title: 10 unmissable showcases at India Art Fair 2026
item.description: This edition of the India Art Fair brings together 133 exhibitors from across the globe with an extraordinary set of artistic and design display.

item.title: 10 most read (and most beautiful) homes in January in AD India
item.description: From a slow living haven in Kullu to a home in Tamil Nadu that is built around instinct, here are the most beautiful homes featured in AD this month.

item.title: 8 wooden door design ideas with stories to tell
item.description: Spanning eight homes, these wooden door design show how palette, texture, and narrative can transform a threshold into a moment of design intent.

item.title: In this Hyderabad penthouse, Indian craft meets a global design language
item.description: Designed by Ashiesh Shah as an ode to Indian craftsmanship, this Hyderabad penthouse was built to entertain.

item.title: At Satish Gujral's centennial exhibition, the memory of Partition looms large
item.description: The first Indian artist to train in Mexico, the late modern master was never afraid to push the boundaries of art, ideas, and materials. A major new retrospective at NGMA in New Delhi honours his multifaceted legacy.

item.title: This builder-grade apartment in Bengaluru is transformed into an oasis of Zen
item.description: A modern, almost minimalist tone defines the ethos of this very organic Bengaluru apartment, home to a young doctor couple. Designed by Priyanka Khandekar and Shubham Shingate of Studio SP_ACE, brass, glass and hints of black meet limestone, wood and marble to create a mindful balance.

item.title: 5 quirky furniture design brands that made it to our wishlist
item.description: This furniture design edit is a celebration of unexpected forms, experimental materials, and quirky ideas you didn’t see coming.

item.title: Inside 9 unique Indian homes designed by AD100 architects and designers
item.description: From a cave-like farmhouse in Coimbatore to a stone cottage in Haryana, here are the most unique Indian homes created by AD100 talents.

item.title: 12 hill station hotels in India for a picture-perfect destination wedding
item.description: Come for the celebrations, stay for the picturesque views—these hill station hotels in India set the stage for a dreamy exchange of vows.
